name: painted concrete floor
description: Cold concrete with a faded yellow parking line.  The lines go on in every direction, marking bays for cars that were never here.

name: puddle
description: A shallow pool of cold water that has collected in a dip in the concrete.  It smells of rust and oil.

name: pipe-lined wall
description: A concrete wall crowded with rusted pipes.  Some of them drip.  Some of them are warm.  None of them seem to go anywhere.

//: Renewable but unsafe water (plain 'water', needs boiling). Unlimited terrain water is what NPC thirst code looks for, so NPCs within 6 tiles drink here on their own.
name: drip pool
description: A leaking pipe overhead drips steadily into a pool that never quite overflows and never quite runs dry.  The water is cold and tastes of rust.  Boil it first.

//: Renewable clean water for the Breakroom. NPCs within 6 tiles drink here on their own.
name: rigged tap
description: A valve someone has cut into the pipes and run through a bucket of sand, charcoal and cloth.  The water that trickles out is clear and cold.  A strip of tape on it reads, in marker: CLEAN.  DON'T WASTE IT.
